newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Asia Investment down due to low debut price.
newsitem.headline: Japan Asia Investment down due to low debut price.

text.p: Shares in newly listed Japan Asia Investment Co Ltd were down on the over-the-counter (OTC) market on Thursday, depressed by the initial price of the shares which was lower than expected, brokers said.
The shares, which were listed on Wednesday, were down 70 yen at 1,400 at 0150 GMT, with trade volume of 2.23 million shares, ranking top of the OTC's most heavily traded list, brokers said.
The public offer price of the shares was 1,400 yen and the initial price was 1,470, contrary to hopes that the price would be as high as 2,000 yen, brokers said.
Japan Asia Investment provides loans for ventures in Japan and other parts of Asia.
